cohort: Consecutively selected patients with singleton pregnancies who underwent routine examinations between 18.0 and 23.6 weeks of gestation.
finding: A more obtuse uterocervical angle in the second trimester was associated with an increased occurrence of spontaneous preterm birth before 37 weeks.
gest_age: Exposure measurement at 18.0-23.6 weeks; Outcome defined as birth before 37 weeks
